title: Ada and the Safehouse
author: Freya Nakamura
blurb: Yara Lockridge, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
